name: Diza AI Auto-Blogger – AI Autoblog & SEO Article Writer
author: dizitalsquare

sections.description:
Diza Auto-Blogger is an automated AI blogging and SEO content generator for your WordPress site. Powered by GPT-4o and Google Gemini, it outlines, drafts, structures, and schedules high-quality blog posts designed to rank.

No developer skills required. Simply connect your Diza AI account, pick your niche, set a schedule, and watch the plugin work in the background.

External Services

This plugin connects to external cloud APIs provided by Diza AI (https://dizaai.com), OpenAI (https://openai.com), and Google Gemini (https://ai.google.dev) to generate, optimize, and schedule blog articles, outline topics, and generate branded cover images.

  • Diza AI Cloud Engine: https://dizaai.com
    • Terms of Service: https://dizaai.com/terms.php
    • Privacy Policy: https://dizaai.com/privacy.php
    • Description: The plugin connects to the Diza AI Cloud Engine to validate account connectivity and proxy AI article generation requests securely without exposing raw API keys on the client site.
  • OpenAI API: https://openai.com
    • Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
    • Description: Optional direct service integration. Site administrators may provide their own OpenAI API key in settings if they wish to generate featured cover images using DALL-E 3.
  • Google Gemini API: https://ai.google.dev
    • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Description: An optional AI language model provider routed via the Diza AI Cloud Engine to draft and structure blog content.

Key Features

  • SEO-Optimised Output: Generates structured long-form content with H1/H2/H3 tags, keywords, and intro/conclusions.
  • 1-Click Connect: Sign up, authorize your site, and activate your license instantly without copy-pasting API keys.
  • AI Cover Art: Generate branded feature images automatically for each post.
  • Smart Scheduler: Set publication schedules (hourly, daily, weekly) matching your local timezone.
  • Review Mode: Option to publish drafts first for your approval before going live.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/diza-auto-blogger directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘Diza Auto-Blog’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click ‘Connect Diza AI Account’ to verify your site and activate your free quota.
sections.faq:
Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

No. Diza AI provides the AI model access out-of-the-box through your Diza AI account. You only need your own OpenAI key if you choose to enable the optional DALL-E 3 featured image generation.

How do article limits work?

Limits reset on the 1st of every month. The Free Tier includes 5 articles/month. Starter includes 50/month, and Pro includes 200/month.

1.5.6

  • Built-in Anti-Duplication Engine: Added WordPress database memory check querying previously published titles before topic planning, strictly preventing the AI from repeating, paraphrasing, or generating duplicate titles.
  • Multi-Topic Round-Robin: Implemented smart keyword rotation across user-specified comma-separated categories to guarantee all topics receive balanced, equal publication.
  • Dynamic Mixed Variety Shuffling: Upgraded “Mixed Variety (Smart Blend)” with programmatic format rotation across Why Explainers, What Listicles, How-To Blueprints, and Case Studies.
  • Strict Custom Editorial Rules Enforcement: Elevated custom instructions to highest priority directives to guarantee strict adherence to title formats, question phrasing, and Why/How/What rotation.
  • Algorithmic Similarity Validator: Real-time title similarity check automatically detects and regenerates any proposed title exceeding 65% similarity to past posts.

1.5.5

  • Watermark-Free Featured Images: Replaced third-party AI image generation with pristine, zero-watermark high-resolution editorial photography tailored to your specific blog niche, topic, and category.
  • High-Definition 16:9 Cover Art: Guaranteed crystal-clear, royalty-free featured images with no branding, logos, or watermarks.
  • Enhanced Image Reliability: Direct, robust image sideloading to the WordPress Media Library with zero external dependencies.

  • Dynamic Mixed Variety Style: Added “Mixed Variety (Smart Blend)” as the primary recommended article style in Step 1. The AI intelligently alternates formats across how-to tutorials, listicles, industry insights, and case studies to maximize content diversity and reader engagement.

  • Smart Category Auto-Detection: Added dynamic category selector in Step 1. Auto-detects and creates relevant topic categories (e.g. Marketing, Technology) or matches existing WordPress categories, eliminating “Uncategorized” defaults.
  • Auto-Repair for Existing Posts: Automatically cleanses previously generated articles tagged with “Uncategorized” to relevant categories in the Auto-Blog Manager.

1.5.2

  • Real-Time Calendar Anchoring: Enforced current real-world year calibration across all article outlines, titles, and body content, preventing past years (e.g. 2024) from appearing in generated content.

  • 1-Click Draft Publisher: Added single-click publishing tools for existing draft articles directly in the Auto-Blog Manager.
  • Clean Post Analytics: Removed simulated views counter and consolidated post date formatting for accurate post management.

  • Custom AI Instructions & Editorial Rules: Added dedicated multi-line custom instructions field in Step 2 to enforce unique blog formatting rules, title structures, and specific writing guidelines.
  • Overhauled Step 5 (Test & Connect): Added real-time usage monitor displaying active plan, remaining monthly articles, and visual progress bar directly on settings page.
  • Direct Test Generator: Connected accounts can now trigger test article generation directly from Step 5 without navigating away.
  • Resolved Trial Status Confusion: Stage 1 automatically acknowledges connected accounts without confusing trial lock alerts.
  • Anti-AI Humanizer Engine: Automatically filters out robotic clichés and AI phrasing for natural, authentic human tone.
  • Guaranteed Internal Link Injector: Ensures target links and anchors are naturally woven into paragraphs or framed in contextual resource callouts.

1.4.4

  • Single-Row Hero Banner: Realigned trial information and signup button into a seamless, unified horizontal row.
  • Dashboard Setup Wizard Avatar: Replaced generic robot emoji in the WordPress Dashboard onboarding notice with the official Diza Robot graphic.

  • Official Diza Robot Asset: Integrated authentic Diza Robot graphic across the hero header and action loading screen.
  • Enhanced Hero Conversion: Upgraded trial banner to “Signup & Get 5 Articles Every Month Free” with direct quick-action button.
  • Auto Blogger Naming: Standardized “Auto Blogger Live” status across hero controls and schedule accordions.
  • Enforced Free Trial Limits: Capped trial indicator at 2/2 and disabled test generation once quota is exhausted with clear guidance to sign up.
  • Vibrant Action & Indigo CTA: Upgraded account connection CTA to high-converting Indigo gradient and modernized the generation progress overlay with multi-phase tracking.

1.4.2

  • Redesigned Hero Section: Added Diza Robot avatar, synchronous Auto-Pilot toggle, and prominent 2-post free trial + 5-post monthly benefit banner.
  • Premium Smoothed Fields: Refined input dimensions, smoothed borders, and aligned grids for a balanced aesthetic.
  • 3-Stage Progression in Step 5: Clearly structured trial generation, free monthly account connection, and scalable paid plans.
  • Prominent Centered Save Button: Added a high-contrast, centered primary finish button.

1.4.1

  • Streamlined Setup Wizard: Removed clutter and unnecessary field descriptions for a clean, minimal interface.
  • Overhauled Step 4: Replaced bloated review controls and redundant master buttons with a single modern Auto-Pilot toggle switch.
  • Compact Choice Cards: Redesigned all choice cards into compact, modern pills.
  • Improved Error Handling: Fixed generation response parsing to deliver human-friendly error messages and prevent raw 429 status code alerts.
  • Increased Free Trial Quota: Expanded instant trial allowance to 5 sample articles.

1.4.0

  • Major UX Redesign: Implemented an intuitive 5-step accordion setup wizard inspired by modern onboarding best practices.
  • Plain, friendly language: Replaced confusing technical jargon with clear, step-by-step guidance.
  • Choice Cards: Added visual cards for industry niches, article types (how-tos, listicles, thought leadership), word length, and writing tones.
  • Instant 2-Article Trial: New users can test AI post generation with live visual progress before connecting an account.
  • Auto-Pilot Controls: Simplified scheduling and active/paused engine controls with safe draft review mode.
  • Collapsible Developer Drawer: Moved advanced BYOK API keys and custom prompt settings into a discrete bottom section.

1.3.4

  • Renamed plugin display name to Diza AI Auto-Blogger.
  • Redesigned settings page with visual 3-step setup guide and interactive Active/Paused auto-pilot toggle switch.
  • Added 2 Free Instant Trial Articles (no signup required) for friction-free onboarding.
  • Streamlined settings into minimal, clean layout with collapsible advanced SEO and prompt customization.
  • Added official WordPress.org directory banners and UI screenshot assets.

1.3.3

  • Added polite in-admin review prompt notice with direct 1-click rating link on WordPress.org and snooze options.

1.3.2

  • Renamed plugin to Diza Auto-Blogger with official slug diza-auto-blogger.
  • Removed external fallback image dependencies for full WordPress.org directory compliance.
  • Expanded External Services disclosures and Serviceware documentation.
  • Standardized text domains to diza-auto-blogger.

1.3.1

  • Compliance update: Added explicit Third-Party Services disclosures and privacy links.
  • Updated compatibility tags for WordPress 7.1.
  • Refined editorial prompt formatting and encoding.
  • Added contributor author mappings.

1.3.0

  • Initial release of Diza Auto-Blogger.
